ns2:section.sectionText: This online lecture section is intended for students who are not able to return to campus do to COVID-19. Please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu) for an override to register. MechSE students must obtain department approval from staff to drop this course after the 10th day of class.Please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Mechanics or Mechanical Engineering major(s).
